notes.title: Tormented Souls 2 release date revealed!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone, drumroll please… 🥁🥁🥁 [/h3][p][/p][p]It’s time to prepare yourselves for an entirely new nightmare as [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464280/Tormented_Souls_2/"]Tormented Souls 2[/url] launches on [b]23rd October 2025! [/b] [/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the rapidly-approaching release of the next instalment in the series we’ve partnered with the [b]Future Games Show at Gamescom 2025[/b] to showcase a pulse-pounding [b]new gameplay trailer[/b], and reveal first details of the [b]monstrous bosses [/b]that Caroline will encounter while exploring the hellish[b] ‘Other side[/b]’ of Villa Hess.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/8130011b6809b1f4e03959fedfd11c99c204c303.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]⚠️⚠️WARNING! Spoilers for Tormented Souls ahead! ⚠️⚠️[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Check out the ‘A New Nightmare’ Gameplay Trailer as seen in the Future Games Show Gamescom Showcase![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="2tW08Oy7QmY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
In the wake of her sister [b]Anna’s[/b] traumatic abduction at the hands of [b]Mother Lucia [/b]and her twisted cult, [b]Caroline Walker[/b] finds herself trapped deep within the walls of a maze-like convent. With the darkness closing in, Caroline is unexpectedly reacquainted with her old friend, the pneumatic nailer, and so begins a desperate struggle to escape the unholy place. But once free of the convent, the true horror of the secluded [b]Villa Hess[/b] reveals itself and Caroline must again [b]call upon her supernatural abilities[/b] to travel to the town’s mysterious [b]‘Other side’[/b] and face the formidable creatures that await within…[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Switching realities[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/ce51573734c5757f933c3717242bf470475956ce.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In the original [b]Tormented Souls[/b] it was Caroline’s latent supernatural powers that allowed her to[b] utilise mirrors and video tapes[/b] to traverse between [b]alternate realities[/b] and [b]timelines[/b] to ultimately save Anna from her cruel fate. [/p][p]
In [b]Tormented Souls 2[/b], Caroline will continue to embrace these powers as she steps into Villa Hess’ mysterious ‘Other side’ and ‘replays’ memories stored on video tapes. Crucially Caroline’s actions in these locations will directly affect the current timeline in Villa Hess, while revealing more about the town’s dark history.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The horrors of the ‘Other side’[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Only the [b]foulest and most dangerous creatures[/b] reside within the ‘Other side’ and Caroline must be extra vigilant when exploring this twisted new reality. Deadliest of all are[b] beings of immense power[/b] that have gorged on the misery and corruption that envelops the region. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/2b84dd25ebd3bb1d8b6f349903891dfc5ee8c85d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Wielding a huge crucifix and protected by a heavy plated mask, the [b]Iron Maiden[/b] is a hulking behemoth and cruel disciplinarian who administers punishment amongst the convent’s sisterhood.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/ebae69e4daf50e15406e4fdf7dcfa12b1d879c97.png"][/img][/p][p]
Meanwhile, deep beneath the stinking halls of the [b]Wildberger & Hess Fish Processing Plant[/b] sleeps [b]The Harvester[/b], a terrifying fusion of twisted metal and scorched flesh. Armed with a lethal buzzsaw and gaping maw filled with razor sharp teeth, this subterranean horror seems impervious to all but the heaviest of weapons. [/p][p][/p][p]Until next time!
[/p][p]Dual Effect & PQube[/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: 🚨Tormented Souls 2 demo and new look for Caroline incoming!🚨
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

It’s been quite some time since our last post but today we’re finally ready to share some big news regarding [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464280/Tormented_Souls_2/][b]Tormented Souls 2[/b][/url] which has been selected to feature in the [b]Latin American Games Showcase[/b] taking place on on [b]7th June @ 11am PT / 7pm BST[/b] via [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lagshowcase]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@LAGShowcase]YouTube.[/url]

To celebrate we’ll be releasing a [b]brand new story teaser trailer[/b] during the event which introduces several major characters, and shines the spotlight on the [b]mysterious town[/b] that Caroline will be exploring over the course of the game. Keep an eye out for several never before seen locations 👀 

On top of this we’ll also be revealing an entirely [b]redesigned look for Caroline[/b] which not only reflects feedback we have received since announcement, but also pays tribute to her iconic style from the original [b]Tormented Souls[/b]! We can’t wait to share this with you but for now here’s a sneak peak of our [b]brand-new keyart[/b] (hot of the press!) featuring a familiar looking silhouette 😉  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/f99bd6f63e96d2530d9b4341efd2914ea4118751.jpg[/img]

But that’s not all! We’re proud to announce that our [b]first playable Steam demo[/b] will be available to play the day before the showcase [b]on June 6th at approximately 8am PT / 4pm BST[/b] 🥳This demo will feature the [b]first 60 minutes of gameplay[/b] and will have you navigating the claustrophobic passageways of a sinister convent in search of a gruesome ancient tome…

Lastly, we just wanted to say thank you for your patience and support over the last year. It's been a long road getting to this point, but we’re finally on the home stretch and can’t wait to share more news and information over the coming months as we head towards launch in late 2025 😀

Until next time!

Dual Effect & PQube

notes.title: 🕯️ Tormented Souls 2 is Announced! The Survival Horror Classic Is Back! 🕯️
notes.notes:
Hello survival horror fans…

We are extremely excited to announce that Tormented Souls 2 is coming soon to Steam!

Caroline Walker returns in the highly anticipated sequel to the award-winning classic survival horror! Stalk the shadow-drenched halls of haunting monasteries and other nightmarish locations, and brace yourself to confront terrifying creatures armed only with makeshift weapons as you desperately try to rescue your cursed sister.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/dee23828ba5bc12c19e4a53358ec8eed851147ae.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=sdukBQuWCcE;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/ce9dc316849677a1734c682d20635699b4abe482.png[/img]
After the events at Wildberger Hospital, Caroline yearns for a normal life with her younger sister, Anna. However, fate has other plans. Conventional remedies prove futile as Anna falls victim to a mysterious affliction, coughing blood and experiencing blackened eyes and moments of unconsciousness. In a desperate bid to save her sister, Caroline must turn to the supernatural..,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/d615541768b39d63670daa1401c59b4baaec36fb.png[/img]
Step into the nightmare that is Puerto Miller, a remote Southern American town with a chilling past. Founded by the antient, reclusive Ismuit tribe, the town conceals unspeakable horrors beneath its ancient exterior. Explore its dark secrets if you dare...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/60c0df89212659ffde04ad22f384d2568088d429.png[/img]
Face pulse-pounding combat as you confront monstrous creatures using a range of ingenious makeshift weapons. Every corner may hide an enemy, so resource management is key to survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/3f8239c7a7b7d213e6cba9938880be9773a12de5.png[/img]
Utilise logic and reasoning to forge connections between items found in the environment and intricately designed puzzles. Creatively combine resources to unlock twisted enigmas and delve deeper into the dark mysteries that shroud your path. 🧠🔐

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/d23dda85b3555d99df908f79a77cf0aadaf6b608.png[/img]

[u][h3][b]Wheel Monster:[/b][/h3][/u]
Old people [b]suffering from dementia and abandoned by their relatives[/b] were subjected to horrible experiments. [b]Their eyes were removed[/b] and a device planted into their heads to send vibrations directly to their brains to [b]pounce on anything that creates a sound. [/b]

They are extremely fast as they travel in a wheelchair and their [b]extremely long skeletal claws[/b] attached to their arms.

It can [b]tear flesh with its claws of surgical steel[/b] once at close range.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/c898e67c405cbc7daecb26b1d58c1fde66d9b612.png[/img]

[h2]Want to experience the next generation of classical survival horror controls?[/h2]

The [b]modern control scheme[/b] updates this classic genre for today's players, offering 360° movement and bringing familiarity to players of all levels of experience.

The [b]Dynamic Camera[/b] offers fixed-perspective thrills for hardcore fans - but also gives players the ability to adjust camera angles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/517cb23663c95e04dd9b6da2f08d367f9e2d6a74.png[/img]

[h2]There will be mainly 3 types of cameras:[/h2]

[h3]Rotating camera:[/h3]

Placed on a specific point and will only [b]follow the player on an angular basis[/b] allowing to span wider routes than the static camera. 

This will be the most used type of camera throughout the game [b]giving more control[/b] on what’s what wants to be shown for the director.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/e54284adb582111705c317f384634031518c7556.gif[/img]

[h3]Rail camera:[/h3]

[b]Following the character[/b] through a rail keeping a constant distance. They will be used to span long routes like corridors and will give a cinematographic look to the game. 

Each camera will have a [b]different focal aperture[/b] and focus

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/6410979a8f29eea86caf62957f8b9e7f62e7fb96.gif[/img]

[h3]Static camera: [/h3]

Ubicated on a specific place pointing in a [b]unique direction.[/b] They won’t move or rotate in any direction, will be used to show places of interest.

notes.title: Fighting against the horrors
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/c898e67c405cbc7daecb26b1d58c1fde66d9b612.png[/img]

[h2]How do you fight your way through Wildberger Hospital?[/h2]

[b]Dark forces and unspeakable horrors[/b] will do everything in their power to stop Caroline from finding out the truth. [b]Use anything and everything[/b] that you can find to [b]fight back the evils[/b] that wait in the darkness.

Your range of weapons and usage is [b]essential to your survival.[/b] Not only can you use your nailgun to stun from afar but you can also use a crowbar for the[b] final blow[/b] and to conserve your ammunition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/026eb894d2031a1d444955134a11c41d468f3b78.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Aim:[/b][/h3]
Sticking to the [b]classic tank controls[/b], Caroline will aim at the closest enemy while using the direction of the axis will change the target.

You can also back-step whilst aiming if the [b]enemy becomes too close[/b] and deals a fatal blow to Caroline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/67f9a112bf2c468f8e90c54a1e4d0c5524b1771a.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Shooting:[/b][/h3]
While aiming at an enemy, using the [b]action button to shoot[/b] the current target. This action will
use your ammunition and will lower the stamina level of the damaged enemy.

Use the crowbar to your advantage and[b] deliver the final blow [/b]when the enemy is down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/2ebcd1dcc52dea7fba3ac5d2564970b992529626.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Reload:[/b][/h3]
Caroline’s weapon will have to reload using the reload button so she doesn’t get surprised and with no way of attack. Conserving ammunition is also vital to survival.

Make sure you [b]check your surroundings[/b] before you reload, you never know what's [b]hiding in the shadows.[/b]

[h3][b]Who is Caroline Walker?[/b][/h3]

Caroline Walker, an average and very normal elementary school teacher, [b]received a strange letter[/b] containing a strange polaroid picture of two twin girls.

While investigating the disappearance of two twin girls at the decrepit mansion at Winterlake-[b]something terrible happens[/b] to Caroline Walker... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/13e68bed6066c4f7fa79117467fe4872dc3756f0.gif[/img]

Ever since she looked at the photo, all[b] she could see was them looking right back at her[/b] every time her eyes closed. From that moment on, nothing was the same. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/d4a8c8d8fd096c7e6b821e01093f5e417caf7506.png[/img]

[h3][b]What's inside Winterlake Mansion?[/b][/h3]

After receiving the letter and experiencing a week of [b]strange symptoms[/b] she knew she couldn't continue with her normal life. She started to feel [b]anxious[/b] during the day and having[b] horrible nightmares.[/b] That's when she realized she had no choice but to visit the mansion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/2f12102ccbf8ba5ae84fa05288010d5574fa93b6.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Will you help her escape?[/b][/h3]

Upon entering the hospital converted mansion, the quiet and eerie atmosphere surrounded her, and before she could investigate further she is knocked over by a mysterious stranger. Confused and alone, Caroline wakes up in a bathtub connected to breathing machines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458019/74bf5ebbccf0a23e16f649a63c87783283a1a8e0.gif[/img]
